newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel quiet, cargoes remain tight.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel quiet, cargoes remain tight.

text.p: NWE jet fuel cargo premiums were discussed firmer on Tuesday on continuing tight supply, traders said.
Benchmark Dec IPE futures advanced $2.75 to $222.50 a tonne, helped by NYMEX heating oil which pushed up from early lows.
Cargo premiums were around $1 firmer at Dec IPE +$34 cif NWE, with thin demand chasing limited supply of larger parcels. Barges remained long with premiums unchanged around Dec IPE +$26 fob ARA.
The Med remained quiet with premiums around fob Med high +$4.
